rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a farewell or the act of taking leave, including a final parting.

example.english: We said farewell to our family before boarding the ship.
example.traditional: 我哋臨上船之前同屋企人道別。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 lam4 soeng5 syun4 zi1 cin4 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 dou6 bit6
